subject: How to get the state of particles??

messages.author: 035bdcbafcb34400
messages.subject: How to get the state of particles??
parts:
Hi all nimble users!!

I have a question about bootstrap filter.
I use buildBootstrapFilter() and this function have a argument of "saveALL".

I want to see the state of particle filter at all time point, so I set this argument TRUE.
However, cModel$run(parNum) return only log-likelihood.

How can I see the state of particle filter at all time point??
I can't find any way to do this in nimble user manual.

I'm sorry for this easy and basic question...

Thanks, 
Oyama

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: How to get the state of particles??
parts:
Dear Oyama,
Thanks for the question. Unfortunately at the moment I can't sit down and work out a more thorough answer, so I want to at least give you a quick reply. I hope it is helpful. The two more thorough sources for documentation would be the help pages in the nimbleSCR package and also this paper:

DOI: 10.18637/jss.v100.i03

https://www.jstatsoft.org/article/view/v100i03

I think it should be possible to do what you want.

Perry
